summary: Comprehensive testing of Enhanced Friendly Match System. All 6 backend endpoints tested and passing. All frontend features verified with screenshots.
seed_data_creation: Used existing team Storm G14 (GZXU1Y) and network team Monolitten 2012 (MUH2Z7)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All friendly match features implemented and working: create invite, accept/decline, cancel, amend dates, delete cancelled/declined. Network picker shows teams with codes. Calendar popup has clickable dates with past dates grayed out.

Backend: POST /api/friendly-invites.details: Creates invite with proposed_dates, home_away, pitch_name, pitch_address. Creates messages for both sender and receiver.

Backend: PUT /api/friendly-invites/{id}/.details: Accept with selected date/time or decline. Status changes accordingly.
Sets status to cancelled and creates notification message for other team.
Changes status back to pending with new proposed_dates. Clears accepted_date/time.

Backend: DELETE /api/friendly-invites/{i.details: Only allows deletion of cancelled/declined invites. Returns 404 for pending/accepted.

Frontend: INVITE button and layout.details: Green + INVITE button in header. Friendly Matches page layout working.

Frontend: Invite modal with network pick.details: Team code input with 'Or pick from My Network' toggle. Shows network teams with codes (#MUH2Z7).

Frontend: Calendar popup.details: Custom calendar with month navigation (< >), clickable dates, past dates grayed out.

Frontend: Accepted matches with buttons.details: Shows 'Team A vs Team B' headline format. GO TO MATCH (green), AMEND (green border), CANCEL (red border) buttons visible.

Frontend: Cancelled/Declined section wit.details: CANCELLED / DECLINED section shows with 'Cancelled' red label and trash-can-outline icon for deletion.

Frontend: Pending invitations headline.details: Shows 'Team A vs Team B' headline and 'Tap to respond' hint.

Frontend: Respond modal with date select.details: SELECT DATE section shows proposed dates with time slots. ACCEPT (green) and DECLINE (red border) buttons.

Frontend: Amend modal.details: Propose New Dates modal with calendar popup. Shows current accepted date. PROPOSE NEW DATES button.
